Resolves #3624

Docs now separates application classes into an Apps tab while API remains the default. Both navigation trees use native Store projections of one root-provider structure index, so application and mixin source links retain their URLs and work while Apps is unopened or hidden by search. Search includes all three tabs; Examples keeps its development-only availability through a stable button reference.

Change class: capability.
Evidence: L2 (local browser DOM plus live App-worker state on generated Docs data) → L2 required; no deferred acceptance.

## AC Evidence
No structured ACs on #3624. The remaining scope and intake contract are recorded in [the maintainer intake](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/3624#issuecomment-6665625805); the empty-folder half was already delivered by #20244 / #3240.

| Intake acceptance | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Separate API/Apps; API default | CI-covered `MainContainerController.spec.mjs`; live browser checks API selection and excludes the Docs app class from its Store. |
| Search all three trees | Existing `DocsNavigationSearch.spec.mjs` plus Apps filtering in `DocsMixinsNL.spec.mjs`. |
| Source routes independent of active tab/query | `DocsMixinsNL.spec.mjs` opens an app source before Apps is selected, then opens it with its leaf filtered out; existing mixin-source journey retained. |
| Examples disabled only outside development | CI-covered development/production assertions on the actual Examples header button. |
| One load; complete subtrees; cleanup | Unit coverage includes arbitrary root IDs, reload removing Apps, and destruction of all provider-owned Stores; browser observes one structure request. |

## Deltas from ticket
No generator or engine API change. The existing ApiTreeList loader is removed; the root view owns the single load. The highlighter resource test now supplies the generator's `src` root and child chain. [The retained projection experiment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/3624#issuecomment-6665814453) explains why ancestry reads the source Store instead of an insertion callback's absent `allItems` argument. The original contributor's request remains intact.

## Test Evidence
Local browser: two generated-data Neural Link journeys, the literal-navigation-search case, and all three HighlightJsResources cases (Docs, embedded Portal, Toast) pass with zero retries, using the explicit e2e config and isolated server/Bridge ports. The app journey checks DOM source content alongside worker records and line state; its screenshot was inspected.

Focused Docs units, syntax, whitespace and file-size checks pass. `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; commit/push hooks and hosted PR baseline cover their available checks.

## Post-Merge Validation
None required; the accepted navigation and route behavior is exercised before merge.

    - Examples is disabled through the `examples-tab-button` reference instead of a numeric item path.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Documented search**: I actively looked for the following and found no concerns.
  - **A search wiping the root scope:** `tree/List#filter` walks `me.store` (the projection's already-filtered items) and toggles VDOM `display`. It never assigns `store.filters`, so `filterByRoot` survives every query.
  - **A global id collision from `sourceId: 'structure'`:** `state/Provider` resolves "sibling store-key `sourceId` values to their concrete instance ids", so a second Docs instance gets its own structure store.
  - **Store ownership:** the projections and `structure` belong to the provider, and `ApiTreeList` opts out of `autoDestroyStore`. The provider-destruction unit case covers both.
- **Non-blocking, to watch:**
  1. `filterByRoot` walks each record's ancestor chain per filter pass, which is O(n·depth). That's fine at Docs scale; the index sizes it, not the user.
  2. The missing-docs hint keeps its inline `style="padding: 1em"`. It was moved here, not introduced, but a SCSS class would fit the "styles stay in SCSS" norm better.
